'''Brian Kim''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II Booster Draft]] on 6 May 2000 with sealed (Dune Sea Sabacc with a Jawa), according to Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d707">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapoconii-day-2-trs-from-cgd707/ ramapoconii-day-2-trs-from-cg], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapoconii-day-2-trs-from-cgd707/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
